paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of silent thought (ST) tokens, denoted as C, and two performance metrics—accuracy and inference time—on the GSM8K benchmark. The x-axis represents the ST Token Number C, ranging from 0 to 30 in increments of 5, using a linear scale. The left y-axis measures Accuracy (%) with a linear scale from 36% to 43%, while the right y-axis measures Inference time (ms) with a linear scale from 33 ms to 40 ms. The blue line with circular markers shows accuracy: it starts at 36.5% when C=0, increases to 39.5% at C=5, dips slightly to 41.0% at C=10, rises to a peak of 42.5% at C=20, and then decreases to 42.0% at C=30. The red line with square markers represents inference time, which remains relatively stable, starting at 36.5 ms at C=0, slightly decreasing to 36.0 ms at C=5, then gradually increasing to 37.0 ms at C=30.
